newsitem.title: GERMANY: Colonia sees group profit rising from 1995.
newsitem.headline: Colonia sees group profit rising from 1995.

text.p: German insurance group Colonia AG said on Wednesday it expected group profit to rise this year from 1995's 210 million marks and that it planned to continue a policy of rising dividends.
"The CKAG Colonia Konzern AG is confident on the basis of its development in the 1996 year so far that it can improve its group result again," a statement said.
"In a letter distributed to shareholders...the company therefore restated its goal of continuing its dividend policy with increasing rates," it said.
Colonia paid a 28 percent dividend on ordinary shares in 1995 and 30 percent on preference shares.
